copy.curiosityHook: With a high-stakes date hanging in the balance, can Max survive his dad's old-school vacation before their clashing agendas derail the journey entirely?
copy.description: Max wants to impress his high school crush, but his plans are abruptly derailed when his well-meaning father, Goofy, whisks him away on an unexpected cross-country road trip packed with chaotic mishaps.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, fast-paced, and warm, this breezy animated family adventure offers easy laughs with gentle emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: This energetic animated comedy balances slapstick road-trip adventure with an honest father-son dynamic, delivering genuine warmth in a brisk 78-minute journey.

allowedMaterial: Father-son conflict between old-school parenting and independence
excludedMaterial: Specific concert or destination climax events
Whether Max reunites with his crush or how his lie plays out
